content_zh:
第〇三章 死到临头了
这一瞬间，四周静得落针可闻，房间里的画面也似凝结了起来：散落着木屑的房间门口，头发凌乱的少女被一高一矮两名男子抓着手臂，眼中泪水盈盈；少女身前，一名獐眉鼠眼的年轻男子正捏着她的面颊，戏谑的笑容僵在了脸上，四个人都是目瞪口呆地看着坐在床上的聂空。
少女最先醒来，看着往床沿挪动双腿的聂空，惊喜交加，连忙用力甩脱还在愣神的武童三人，扑到床前，语无伦次的叫道：「醒了，终于醒了……叔叔，你没死，真是太好了……」眼泪簌簌掉落。
「嫂嫂，别哭，我没事。」
聂空长出口气，脸上挤出一丝笑容，目光落在少女脸上，眼神温润，心里有种很自然的亲切和温馨。
这就是他的嫂子花眉，年仅十九，容颜清丽，五官精致秀美，虽哭得眼睛红肿，可这梨花带雨的样子却让她凭添了几分我见犹怜的韵味，也难怪自从三年前嫁进聂家后，聂风行就对她念念不忘。
门口三人也回过神来。
那獐眉鼠眼的男子大摇大摆地走过来，有些意外地打量了聂空两眼，嗤笑道：「原来还没死，命真够硬的。没死也好，花眉，现在用不着为妳小叔子准备丧事，妳还有什么理由推辞不去？」
「我……我跟你们走……」
花眉止住哭声，面颊刷的变得惨白，咬着嘴唇道。
聂空按住花眉肩膀，双眼直勾勾地盯着那男子，那目光就像是在看着一个死人，片刻后嘴角微微一翘：「武童，你都死到临头了，还在这为虎作伥？」
一愣过后，武童捧着肚子笑得直打跌，「真的，这是我二十多年来听到的最好笑的笑话。我今天早上刚刚突破聚灵九品的壁障，成为通灵一品灵师，而且无病无痛，活到一百岁绰绰有余，你居然说我死到临头？聂空，我看你是脑子病糊涂了。」
花眉有些担心地瞟了眼聂空。
灵师，是这个世界一类强大的人群，能够利用天地间的灵力进行修炼，寿命比普通人要长很多。灵师的修炼有聚灵、通灵、融灵、化灵、御灵、虚灵、丹灵、洞灵、天灵九层境界，每层又分九品。武童有通灵一品修为，这只能算是低阶灵师，可对普通人来说，已足可仰视了。
武童抹去眼角笑出来的泪水，脸色倏地一沉，冷声道：「二林，三木，把花眉带走。」
瞥了瞥走来的高矮两名男子，聂空也不着急，似笑非笑的对武童道：「你若不信，可以用手指在第七节颈椎和第一节胸椎之间戳一戳，看看有什么反应，不需动用灵力，只使上三分劲就够了。」
见聂空说得煞有介事，武童阴阳怪气的笑道：「戳戳就戳戳，难道还能把我戳死不成？」说着，右手食指摸到脑后颈椎和胸椎骨节间的空隙，稍微用力点了下去。下一刻，武童只觉头皮炸起，眼前发黑，浑身酥麻，像醉酒般踉踉跄跄前冲几步才稳住身躯，脸色开始有些发白。
聂空道：「感觉怎样？」
「这是怎么回事？」
武童死死地瞅着聂空，心中有些打鼓，他虽稳住了脚步，可脑袋里的眩晕感和身体上的酥麻感却还没有完全消失。

看他神色，花眉便知道聂空说对了，水汪汪的眸子里顿时充满了惊奇。二林和三木两人也情不自禁地停住脚步。
聂空慢声道：「这是你修炼不当所造成的隐疾，原本并不明显，如果你的修为一直停留在聚灵境界，或许要到十年后才会显现，可你今早踏入通灵境界，却让这隐疾提前爆发。看你刚才的样子，显然已非常严重。」
武童脸色变幻不定，强笑道：「笑话？简直胡说八道，要是早就有这所谓的隐疾，我怎么不知道？」
聂空道：「你这次突破到通灵，想必是非常勉强吧？」
「你怎么知道？」武童脱口叫道。
「这就是对了。」
聂空没有回答，只是淡淡地点了点头，然后眼睛转向二林和三木，「你们两个也有同样的隐疾。」
听到聂空和武童的对答，两人对聂空所说已经信了八成，现在听聂空这么一说，两人登时面色大变，抬起手指往脑后戳去。武童紧盯着两人，瞬息后果然见他们身躯摇晃，眼神茫然。
二林和三木晃晃脑袋，脊背上已冒出了冷汗。
武童的脸色更是难看，两只小眼珠子滴溜溜直转，嘿嘿干笑道：「真是……真是无稽之谈，我修炼时完全按照灵诀上面写的进行，怎么可能会修炼不当造成这样的隐疾？二林，三木，你们说对吧？」
两人点着头，面如土色。
聂空摇头不语，将半蹲在床前的花眉扶了起来。当花眉在床沿坐下时，聂空已累得气喘吁吁，额头直冒虚汗。他虽然强行挣脱了植物人状态，可说了这么久的话，几乎已将心力耗空，现在完全是凭毅力在硬撑。
花眉轻抚着聂空脊背，担忧的轻呼道。聂空忙笑了笑，握了握她冰凉的小手，示意自己没事。花眉像受惊的小鹿一般抽回了手掌，脸颊处爬起两团淡淡的红晕。聂空这才意识到自己有些冒失了。
聂空沉默，武童心里有些慌乱，道：「聂空，你怎么不说话？」
聂空眼皮一抬。
武童和善地笑了笑：「你不是说我们有隐疾嘛，这隐疾是怎么出现的你总该跟我们讲清楚吧？」二林和三木两人也是眼巴巴地瞅着聂空，脸上堆满了笑容，神色间露出了讨好的意味。
聂空道：「你们是我什么人？我为什么要告诉你们？」
武童大感气恼，突然眼珠一转，冲二林、三木使了个眼色，指着花眉厉声道，「送她去见三少爷。」
聂空讥诮的道：「看来有些人真的不怕死呀。如果我嫂嫂去见了你们三少爷，她恐怕也活不下去了，既然如此，有三个人陪葬也不错。嫂嫂，你说是吗？」花眉配合地点了几下脑袋。
武童脸色一僵，捋起袖子的二林和三木也畏缩地顿住脚步。

本要威胁这病秧子，却没想到头来竟被他给威胁住了，武童压抑着怒气，阴沉沉的道：「聂空，你到底想要怎样？」
聂空道：「我要怎样，你很清楚。」
武童咬牙道：「好，算你赢了，今天我们不带花眉回去。」
聂空道：「那明天，后天，大后天呢？」
武童两眼一瞪，就要发作，可想到那隐疾，神色又软化下来，「聂家族规摆在那，你父亲是为聂家战死的，只要你还活着，就算三少爷是族长的儿子，也不敢太过分的，有机会的话我也会在三少爷那里说几句话，不过这拖延不了多久，你想保住花眉，最好还是早点想想别的办法。」
「很好。」聂空颔首说道，「你们三个之所以会出现那样的隐疾，主要是因为你们……不姓聂。」
「什么意思？」武童三人一头雾水。
聂空用看白痴一样的目光看着他们：「你们不是真正的聂家族人，只能算是仆人，聂家会将完整的灵诀传授给你们？你们修炼了有缺陷的灵诀，尤其是武童，勉强提升到通灵境界，会将隐疾刺激得更加严重。这并不是什么秘密，所有的聂姓族人都知道，只是瞒着你们这些外姓仆人罢了。」
三人听得嘴巴大张，武童面色阴晴不定：「你说的都是真的？」
聂空道：「你们可以去找其他仆人验证一下。」
「这隐疾要怎么解决？」武童深吸口气。
聂空慢条斯理的道：「告诉你们也无妨，首先，停止修炼。其次，用灵力按揉手心、脚心、头顶半个时辰，每日三次，这『按揉』的动作也有讲究……」聂空将前世的一些按摩手法搬了出来。
二林和三木脑袋点得跟鸡啄米似的，武童疑惑道：「这样就行了。」
聂空冷笑道：「这只是第一阶段，坚持一个月后，隐疾会有所缓解，要想根治，还必须进行第二阶段的治疗。」
「第二阶段是什么？」武童皱眉道。
「一个月后我自然会告诉你们。」
「好！聂空，希望你说的都是真的，否则……」武童龇了龇牙齿，转身出了房间。二林和三木连忙跟上，他们已迫不及待地想要试试聂空所说的那些动作，毕竟这是生死攸关的大事。
「告诉聂风行，『回春露』我会尽快还他。」外面传来哼声，聂空眯起眼睛，虚脱般地靠在了床头。

Chapter 03 Death is imminent
At this moment, the surroundings were so quiet that you could hear the drop of a pin, and the scene in the room seemed to condense: at the door of the room scattered with sawdust, a girl with messy hair was grabbed by the arm of two men, one tall and one short, with tears in her eyes; in front of the girl, a young man with deer-browed eyebrows and rat-like eyes was pinching her cheek, and a playful smile froze on his face. The four of them stared at Nie Kong sitting on the bed with their mouths open.
The girl was the first to wake up. She was filled with surprise when she saw Nie Kong moving his legs to the edge of the bed. She quickly shook off the three Wu Tong who were still stunned, threw herself in front of the bed, and shouted incoherently: "I'm awake, I'm finally awake...Uncle, you're not dead, it's great..." Tears fell from his eyes.
"Sister-in-law, don't cry, I'm fine."
Nie Kong let out a long breath, forced a smile on his face, and his eyes fell on the girl's face. His eyes were warm, and there was a natural kindness and warmth in his heart.
This is his sister-in-law, Huamei, who is only nineteen years old. She has a beautiful face and exquisite facial features. Although her eyes are red and swollen from crying, her pear blossoms with rain make her look a little bit pity for her. It is no wonder that Nie Fengxing has been thinking about her since she married into the Nie family three years ago.
The three people at the door also came to their senses.
The man with deer-browed eyebrows and rat-eyes swaggered over, looked at Nie Kong with some surprise, and sneered: "So you're not dead yet, life is really tough. It's okay that you're not dead, Huamei, now there's no need to prepare for the funeral of your brother-in-law, so why don't you refuse to go?"
"I...I'll go with you..."
Huamei stopped crying, her cheeks turned pale, and she bit her lip.
Nie Kong held down Huamei's shoulders and stared directly at the man. His eyes were like looking at a dead person. After a moment, the corner of his mouth slightly raised: "Wu Tong, you are about to die, and you are still here to help others?"
After being stunned for a moment, Wu Tong held his stomach and laughed until he fell down. "Really, this is the funniest joke I have heard in more than 20 years. I just broke through the barrier of the ninth level of gathering spirits this morning and became a first-level spiritual master. I am free from illness and pain. I can live to be a hundred years old. You actually say that my death is imminent? Nie Kong, I think you are out of your mind."
Huamei glanced at Nie Kong with some worry.
Spiritual masters are a powerful group of people in this world who can use the spiritual power between heaven and earth to practice, and their lifespans are much longer than ordinary people. The spiritual master's training includes nine levels of spiritual gathering, channeling, fusion, spiritual transformation, spiritual control, virtual spirit, alchemy spirit, cave spirit, and heavenly spirit. Each level is divided into nine levels. Wu Tong has a first-level psychic cultivation, which can only be regarded as a low-level spiritual master, but for ordinary people, it is enough to look up to.
Wu Tong wiped away the tears from laughter at the corners of his eyes, his face suddenly darkened, and he said in a cold voice: "Er Lin, San Mu, take Huamei away."
Glancing at the two tall and short men approaching, Nie Kong was not in a hurry, and said to Wu Tong with a half-smile: "If you don't believe it, you can use your finger to poke between the seventh cervical vertebra and the first thoracic vertebra to see what happens. You don't need to use spiritual power, just three-thirds of strength is enough."
Seeing Nie Kong's seriousness, Wu Tong smiled in a sinister manner and said, "Just poke, poke, how can it still kill me?" As he spoke, he touched the space between the cervical and thoracic vertebrae at the back of his head with his right index finger, and pressed it with a little force. The next moment, Wu Tong felt his scalp explode, his vision turned black, and his whole body was numb. He staggered forward a few steps like a drunkard before steadying himself, and his face began to turn pale.
Nie Kong asked, "How do you feel?"
"What's going on?"
Wu Tong stared at Nie Kong, his heart pounding. Although he steadied his steps, the dizziness in his head and the numbness in his body had not completely disappeared.
Looking at his expression, Huamei knew that Nie Kong was right, and her watery eyes were suddenly filled with surprise. Erlin and Sanmu couldn't help but stop.
Nie Kong said slowly: "This is a hidden disease caused by your improper cultivation. Originally,It's not obvious. If your cultivation has stayed in the spirit-gathering realm, it may not appear until ten years later. But when you stepped into the psychic realm this morning, this hidden disease broke out in advance. Judging from your appearance just now, it is obviously very serious. "
Wu Tong's expression changed, and he forced a smile and said, "A joke? That's nonsense. If I had this so-called hidden disease a long time ago, why didn't I know about it?"
Nie Kong said: "You must have been very reluctant to break through to psychic this time, right?"
"How do you know?" Wu Tong blurted out.
"That's right."
Nie Kong did not answer, but nodded lightly, then turned his eyes to Erlin and Sanmu, "You two also have the same hidden disease."
After hearing the exchange between Nie Kong and Wu Tong, the two of them believed 80% of what Nie Kong said. Now when they heard what Nie Kong said, their expressions suddenly changed, and they raised their fingers to poke at the back of their heads. Wu Tong stared at the two of them closely, and after a moment he saw their bodies swaying and their eyes blank.
Erlin and Sanmu shook their heads, cold sweat broke out on their backs.
Wu Tong's face was even more ugly, his two little eyes were rolling, and he laughed and said: "It's really... what a nonsense. When I practiced, I followed the instructions written in the spirit formula exactly. How could I have caused such a hidden disease due to improper cultivation? Erlin, Sanmu, are you right?"
The two nodded, their faces earthy.
Nie Kong shook his head and said nothing, and helped Huamei, who was squatting in front of the bed, up. When Huamei sat down on the edge of the bed, Nie Kong was panting from exhaustion and sweating on his forehead. Although he forced himself out of the vegetative state, talking for so long has almost exhausted his mental energy, and now he is relying entirely on perseverance to hold on.
Huamei caressed Nie Kong's back and whispered worriedly. Nie Kong smiled quickly, shook her cold little hand, and signaled that he was fine. Huamei withdrew her palm like a frightened deer, and two faint blushes appeared on her cheeks. Only then did Nie Kong realize that he had been a little reckless.
Nie Kong was silent, and Wu Tong was a little flustered, saying, "Nie Kong, why don't you speak?"
Nie Kong raised his eyelids.
Wu Tong smiled kindly: "Didn't you say that we have a hidden disease? You should explain to us clearly how this hidden disease appeared, right?" Erlin and Sanmu also looked at Nie Kong longingly, with smiles on their faces, and their expressions showed a flattering look.
Nie Kong said: "Who am I? Why should I tell you?"
Wu Tong was very angry, suddenly rolled his eyes, winked at Erlin and Sanmu, pointed at Huamei and said sternly, "Send her to see the Third Young Master."
Nie Kong said sarcastically: "It seems that some people are really not afraid of death. If my sister-in-law went to see your third young master, she might not be able to survive. In this case, it would be good to have three people buried with her. Sister-in-law, do you think so?" Huamei nodded her head a few times in coordination.
Wu Tong's face froze, and Er Lin and San Mu, who rolled up their sleeves, also stopped in fear.
He originally wanted to threaten the sick man, but he didn't expect to be threatened by him in the end. Wu Tong suppressed his anger and said gloomily: "Nie Kong, what do you want?"
Nie Kong said, "You know very well what I want."
Wu Tong gritted his teeth and said, "Okay, you win, we won't take Huamei back today."
Nie Kong said: "What about tomorrow, the day after tomorrow, and the day after tomorrow?"
Wu Tong glared and was about to have an attack, but thinking of the hidden illness, his expression softened, "The Nie family rules are there. Your father died fighting for the Nie family. As long as you are still alive, even if the third young master is the son of the patriarch, you don't dare to go too far. If I have the chance, I will say a few words to the third young master, but this will not delay for long. If you want to keep Huamei, you'd better think of other ways early."
"Very good." Nie Kong nodded and said, "The main reason why you three have such hidden diseases is because you... are not named Nie."
"What do you mean?" Wu Tong and the other three were confused.
Nie Kong looked at him like an idiotLooking at them: "You are not real members of the Nie family, you can only be regarded as servants. The Nie family will teach you the complete spiritual secrets? You have practiced defective spiritual secrets, especially martial arts. If you are barely promoted to the psychic realm, your hidden diseases will be more serious. This is not a secret. All the Nie clan members know it, but they are just hiding it from you servants with other surnames."
The three of them opened their mouths wide when they heard this. Wu Tong's expression was gloomy and uncertain: "Is everything you said true?"
Nie Kong said: "You can go find other servants to verify."
"How to solve this hidden disease?" Wu Tong took a deep breath.
Nie Kong said slowly: "It's okay to tell you. First of all, stop practicing. Secondly, use spiritual power to massage the palms of the hands, the soles of the feet, and the top of the head for half an hour, three times a day. This "massaging" movement is also particular..." Nie Kong brought out some massage techniques from his previous life.
Erlin and Sanmu nodded like chickens pecking at rice. Wu Tong said doubtfully, "That's enough."
Nie Kong sneered and said: "This is only the first stage. After a month of persistence, the hidden disease will be relieved. If you want to cure it, you must carry out the second stage of treatment."
"What is the second stage?" Wu Tong frowned.
"I will tell you naturally in a month."
"Okay! Nie Kong, I hope what you said is true, otherwise..." Wu Tong bared his teeth and turned around to leave the room. Erlin and Sanmu quickly followed. They couldn't wait to try the moves Nie Kong mentioned. After all, this was a matter of life and death.
"Tell Nie Fengxing that I will return the 'Rejuvenating Dew' to him as soon as possible." There was a hum from outside. Nie Kong narrowed his eyes and leaned against the bedside as if exhausted.
